class.name: RoadTrafficVehicleType
class.brief_description: A kind of road vehicle [RoadTrafficServer] drives.
class.description: The model it is drawn with, its size, how fast it goes and how much of the traffic it makes. Whoever knows the vehicles makes one per vehicle and skin.

members.member: Where the model and its textures are, as a [code]dynamic[/code] names it.
How fast it can go [km/h] ([code]Vmax[/code]); 0 for no limit of its own - the road's then.
The model it is drawn with.
Its skins, by number of the model's replaceable materials.
Its share of the traffic, against the other types'.
